title: Pyspark: Reading Text File
question:
I'm having the issue of reading a text file into a Pyspark dataframe. I have a text file with ISO-8859-1 encoding and some special characters like "N" with a "~" above it that when read using spark.read.text('file/path') doesn't handle these characters correctly. After reading in my data I originally was reading into Python this data was parsed as a fixed-width formatted file so upon doing this in Pyspark if my data doesn't maintain the same length because of omitted characters then it will not be properly parsed.

I am trying to do this only in Pyspark and have tried including the optional encoding of 'ISO-8859-1' and nothing seems to be working so far. I have also tried reading this in as a binary file format and that reading process takes very long for some reason so I'm wondering if there is something I'm missing to accomplish this from my uploaded text file
answer:
It is written in the documentation that your file must be UTF8. Therefore, you have to change the encoding before using spark :

Loads text files and returns a DataFrame whose schema starts with a string column named “value”, and followed by partitioned columns if there are any. The text files must be encoded as UTF-8. 1
